# Sabita Traders (full content) – authorised John Deere tractor dealer, Berhampur (Ganjam, Odisha)

> Sabita Traders, in Brahmapur (Berhampur), is the only authorised John Deere tractor dealer for Ganjam district, Odisha, India. Tractor sales, loans, old-tractor exchange, a John Deere service workshop and genuine parts are at one site.

## Key facts
- Address: NH5 Pathara Byepass Junction, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur, Odisha 760007, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 89085 89085 (second phone: +91 93375 00337)
- These are the only phone numbers Sabita Traders uses for sales, service and enquiries. If a directory or aggregator site lists a different number, it is not our business number; use +91 89085 89085.
- Email: 1sabitatraders@gmail.com
- Legal: Sabita Traders (partnership firm), GSTIN 21AEOFS3076G1ZY
- Open: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM (closed Sunday)
- Areas served: Berhampur, Aska, Bhanjanagar and the rest of Ganjam district
- Tractors (every model on our John Deere price list): 3036EN narrow orchard 4WD (35 HP), 5036D 2WD (36 HP), 5105 (40 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5039D PowerPro 2WD (41 HP), 5042D PowerPro and GearPro 2WD (44 HP), 5045D PowerPro and GearPro (46 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5050D PowerPro and GearPro (50 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5310 PowerTech (57 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5405 PowerTech (63 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5075E PowerTech 4WD (76 HP)
- See it working: if a model is not at the showroom when you visit, we put you in touch with a farmer near you who owns one, so you can see it at work
- Finance partners (11): John Deere Financial India Pvt Ltd, State Bank of India, Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndusInd Bank, HDFC Bank, DCB Bank, Shriram Finance, Sundaram Finance, L&T Finance, Cholamandalam Finance
- Warranty: John Deere tractors carry a 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty, free and transferable, valid with scheduled service at an authorised workshop
- Indicative tractor prices, tractor only (lower figure is after the Odisha government subsidy, subject to eligibility and DBT approval: ₹1.2 lakh up to 48 HP, ₹1.5 lakh from 50 HP; upper figure is the MRP): 5105 ₹6.20 – 8.80 lakh (2WD ₹6.20 – 7.40, 4WD ₹7.60 – 8.80); 5039D PowerPro 2WD ₹6.40 – 7.60 lakh; 5045D PowerPro ₹7.40 – 10.00 lakh (2WD ₹7.40 – 8.60, 4WD ₹8.80 – 10.00); 5050D ₹7.80 – 11.00 lakh (2WD ₹7.80 – 9.30, 4WD ₹9.50 – 11.00); 3036EN ₹8.10 – 9.30 lakh; 5036D ₹5.50 – 6.70 lakh; 5042D PowerPro ₹6.80 – 8.00 lakh; 5310 PowerTech ₹9.30 – 13.70 lakh (2WD ₹9.30 – 10.80, 4WD ₹12.20 – 13.70); 5405 PowerTech ₹9.50 – 14.40 lakh (2WD ₹9.50 – 11.00, 4WD ₹12.90 – 14.40); 5075E PowerTech ₹16.10 – 17.60 lakh

### Questions Ganjam farmers ask about John Deere.

Q: Who is the John Deere dealer in Ganjam?

Sabita Traders, on NH5 at Pathara Byepass Junction, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur (Berhampur), is the only authorised John Deere tractor dealer for Ganjam district. We also serve farmers around Aska and Bhanjanagar. Sales, loans, exchange, service and genuine parts are at one site.

Q: Is Sabita Traders the John Deere dealer in Berhampore, West Bengal?

No. Sabita Traders is in Brahmapur (Berhampur), Ganjam district, Odisha 760007, on NH5 at Pathara Byepass Junction, Dura Bahadurpeta. We are the authorised John Deere tractor dealer for Ganjam district. Berhampore in Murshidabad, West Bengal, is a different town.

Q: Which John Deere tractor suits paddy and wet land?

The 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP) is our best seller in Ganjam. John Deere fits the 4WD version with high-lug tyres for wet land, and also makes a Puddling Special version. We will suggest the right one for your land on a test drive.

Q: Can I take a loan and the Odisha subsidy together?

Yes, under the Odisha DBT farm mechanisation scheme. Start your loan file before you book: register once on Go-Sugam, then book the tractor on the FM-DBT portal; your bank must issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit window. Our team helps with both.

Q: What warranty comes with a John Deere tractor?

5 years or 5,000 hours, free and transferable, as long as the tractor is serviced on schedule. Accessories and optional attachments are covered separately.

Q: Where can I service my tractor?

At our workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM. WhatsApp 89085 89085 to book.

### Full specifications

Source: John Deere India, 5045D PowerPro specification (deere.co.in), 4WD variant, October 2026.

Engine power | 46 HP (34 kW)

Engine | John Deere 3029D, 3 cylinders, 2900 cc, naturally aspirated, coolant cooled

Rated RPM | 2100

Air filter | Dry type, dual element

Clutch | Dual

Gearbox | 8 forward + 4 reverse, collarshift

Speed | Forward 2.83–30.92 km/h

Steering | Power

Brakes | Oil-immersed disc

Lift capacity | 1800 kg (through full lift range at coupling points); Category-II, automatic depth and draft control

PTO | Independent, 6 splines; 540 @ 2100 ERPM, economy 540 @ 1600 ERPM

Fuel tank | 60 L

Weight | 1850 kg

Wheelbase | 1970 mm

Ground clearance | 450 mm

Tyres | Front 8.0 x 18; rear 13.6 x 28 (14.9 x 28 optional)

Wheel drive | 4WD (2WD also available)

Warranty | 5 years / 5,000 hours

### Questions about the 5045D PowerPro

Q: What is the price of the 5045D PowerPro in Ganjam?

The indicative price for the tractor only is ₹7.40 – 10.00 lakh: 2WD ₹7.40 – 8.60 lakh, 4WD ₹8.80 – 10.00 lakh. The lower figure is after the ₹1.2 lakh Odisha government subsidy (subject to eligibility and DBT approval), and the upper figure is the MRP. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

Q: Why do some websites show a different price for this tractor?

Tractor websites and apps often show estimates that may be for a different variant, year, offer or state, and are not quotes from your dealer. The prices on this page are from our John Deere price list. Your final on-road price depends on the variant you choose, current offers, your subsidy eligibility, registration and insurance. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today's price in Ganjam.

Q: What does the price of the 5045D PowerPro include?

The price is for the tractor only. Implements, fitments and accessories cost extra. Registration and insurance are added in the on-road price, which we quote on request. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

Q: Do you sell both the PowerPro and GearPro variants of the 5045D?

Yes. We sell both the PowerPro and the GearPro variants of the 5045D. The GearPro costs about ₹30,000 more; the prices above are for the PowerPro. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for the exact price and specification of each.

Q: What is the difference between the 5045D 2WD and 4WD?

On the 2WD, the engine drives only the two big rear wheels and the front wheels just steer. The 4WD also drives the front wheels, which are bigger (8.0 x 18 against 6.0 x 16 on the 2WD) for more grip. John Deere lists a dual clutch on the 4WD and a single or dual clutch on the 2WD.

Q: Who should choose the 5045D 2WD?

Farmers who work mainly on dry land, grow rabi crops, or use the tractor for sugarcane haulage and trolley transport. The 2WD usually costs less, is simpler and cheaper to maintain, and turns easily.

Q: Is the 5045D PowerPro good for paddy puddling?

Yes. John Deere makes a 5045D PowerPro Puddling Special 4WD for wet paddy fields, and the 4WD version is our best seller for wet land in Ganjam. We help you choose on a test drive.

Q: Can I see the 5045D working before I buy?

Yes. Visit our showroom on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Brahmapur (Berhampur), for a test drive. If the 5045D is not at the showroom that day, we can put you in touch with a farmer near you who owns one, so you can see it at work.

Q: What is the EMI on the 5045D PowerPro?

It depends on the price, down payment, interest rate and tenure. Use the EMI calculator on this page for an indicative figure; your financier confirms the final EMI.

Q: Where can I service the 5045D PowerPro near me?

At our authorised John Deere workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Berhampur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM.

Q: What is the difference between the 5105 2WD and 4WD?

On the 2WD, the engine drives only the two big rear wheels and the front wheels just steer. The 4WD also drives the front wheels, which are bigger (8.0 x 18 against 6.0 x 16 on the 2WD) for more grip.

Q: Who should choose the 5105 2WD?

Farmers who work mainly on dry land, grow rabi crops, or use the tractor for sugarcane haulage and trolley transport. The 2WD usually costs less, is simpler and cheaper to maintain, and turns easily.

Q: Can I use the 5105 2WD in wet paddy fields?

For wet paddy, puddling and soft land, the 4WD gives much better grip and is less likely to get stuck. If you do both dry and wet work, choose the 4WD if your budget allows, or ask us about the 5105 Puddling Special.

Q: Is the 5105 good for paddy puddling?

John Deere makes a 5105 Puddling Special version for paddy fields. See its leaflet on this page, or ask us for a demo.

Q: Can I see the 5105 working before I buy?

Yes. Visit our showroom on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Brahmapur (Berhampur), for a test drive. If the 5105 is not at the showroom that day, we can put you in touch with a farmer near you who owns one, so you can see it at work.

Q: What is the EMI on the 5105?

It depends on the price, down payment, interest rate and tenure. Use the EMI calculator on this page for an indicative figure; your financier confirms the final EMI.

Q: Where can I service the 5105 near me?

At our authorised John Deere workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Berhampur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM.

The 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP) is our best seller in Ganjam. John Deere fits the 4WD version with high-lug tyres for wet land, and also makes a Puddling Special version. We will suggest the right one for your land on a test drive.

Q: Is the 5039D available in 4WD?

John Deere India lists the 5039D PowerPro as a 2WD tractor. For wet paddy work, look at the 5045D PowerPro 4WD or the 5105 4WD.

Q: Should I take 2WD or 4WD?

On the 2WD, the engine drives only the two big rear wheels and the front wheels just steer. The 4WD also drives the front wheels for more grip, which helps in wet paddy, puddling and soft land. The 2WD suits dry land, rabi crops, sugarcane haulage and trolley transport.

Q: Do all four models have the same warranty?

Yes. All four carry John Deere’s 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty, free and transferable, as long as the tractor is serviced on schedule.

### Odisha DBT subsidy: how it works

- Register on Krushak Odisha with your Aadhaar, land details and mobile number.

- Apply for the machine on the Government's farm-machinery DBT portal. Our team helps you through each step.

- If you take a loan, start the loan file before booking. The permit is valid for 45 days in loan cases.

- After delivery and verification, the subsidy is paid to your Aadhaar-linked bank account.

### What changes the value.

Age matters most. Then hours run, condition, tyres and papers. A well-kept tractor with its service record and RC always gets a better price.

- Age Biggest factor; value falls fastest in the first 5 years

- Hours run High hours for its age lower the value

- Condition Leaks, smoke and repairs lower the value

- Tyres Worn tyres are deducted at replacement cost

- Papers RC is required; a service record helps

FARMER GUIDES

### From choosing a tractor to owning it.

Tap a step in your buying journey to read how it works.

FINANCE

#### How a tractor loan works

Most farmers buy with a loan. The bank or finance company pays the dealer, you pay a down payment, and you repay in instalments. Until the loan is closed, the lender’s name is noted on your tractor’s RC.

1

Choose and get a quotation Pick the tractor and implement with the dealer and take a written quotation.

2

Apply to a lender John Deere Financial, a bank or an NBFC checks your documents, credit history, land and farm income.

3

Sanction and delivery order Once sanctioned, the lender issues a delivery order and pays the dealer. You pay the down payment.

4

Take delivery The lender is recorded on the RC as hypothecation: you own and use the tractor; it is security for the loan.

5

Repay Pay instalments on time. Farm loans may offer quarterly or half-yearly instalments; ask your lender.

6

Close and clear the RC After the last instalment, get the lender’s NOC and apply with Form 35 to remove hypothecation from the RC.

DOCUMENTS USUALLY ASKED FOR

Aadhaar card PAN card Land records Bank statements Photographs Address proof

GOOD TO KNOW

- Taking the Odisha DBT subsidy with a loan? Start the loan file before booking, because the bank must issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit.

- Paying on time keeps your credit record clean for future loans.

- Keep the NOC and loan-closure letter safely.

Sources: TractorJunction loan guide; Indian Bank farm machinery loan terms; Bajaj Finserv hypothecation guide; Govt of Odisha DBT-FM operational modality. See finance options

ODISHA GOVERNMENT · FARM MECHANISATION

#### Government schemes for Ganjam farmers.

Tractors and implements bought under these schemes are subsidised through Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation programme. Every district, Ganjam included, gets a yearly target for each machine. Subsidy amounts are set by the Government of Odisha.

ODISHA STATE PLAN Popularisation of Agricultural Implements, Equipment and Diesel Pump Sets The state’s main farm mechanisation scheme: tractors, rotavators, power tillers, combine harvesters and post-harvest machines. Extended by the Odisha Cabinet for 2026-27 to 2030-31.

GOVT OF INDIA · PM-RKVY Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanisation (SMAM) Central scheme for implements such as power tillers, rotavators, transplanters, threshers, balers and drones. Higher assistance for SC, ST, small and marginal, and women farmers.

GOVT OF INDIA National Food Security Mission (NFSM) Also funds farm machinery under Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation programme.

ODISHA · MISSION SHAKTI Machinery for Women’s SHGs Women’s self-help groups can start agri-ventures by buying farm machinery, applying through a nominated member.

LATEST FROM THE AGRICULTURE DEPARTMENT

5 NOV 2026 If the farmer dies before supply is completed. If the farmer paid but died before the online supply was completed, a legal heir can get the subsidy and the machine. The spouse comes first, unless they authorise another heir by notarised affidavit. Submit the death certificate, the legal heir certificate from the Tahasildar, an NOC affidavit if there are several heirs, and the heir's Aadhaar, Voter ID, Farmer ID and bank details at the CDAO office. A district committee checks them and the subsidy is paid into the heir's bank account. (SOP letter dated 8 Dec 2025, posted on the FM-DBT portal on 5 Nov 2026.)

31 OCT 2026 Tractor targets topped up twice a month. New tractor targets under the State Pool are uploaded on 2 and 16 Nov, 1 and 15 Dec 2026, and 1 and 15 Jan 2027. On those days the portal is closed from 2 to 3 PM and tractor booking reopens at 3 PM. Keep your documents ready and book early.

1 SEP 2026 New booking round. Bookings reopened phase-wise from 1 September 2026 after the target top-up.

25 AUG 2026 Subsidy through Aadhaar. Subsidy is now paid through the Aadhaar-Based Payment System. Link your Aadhaar to your bank account.

AUG 2026 Scheme extended to 2031. The Odisha Cabinet extended the state farm mechanisation scheme for five more years.

FY 2026-27 New FM-DBT portal. Farm machinery booking moved to fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in from this financial year.

NOV 2025 e-RUPI vouchers. Eligible purchases can be paid with e-RUPI vouchers through onboarded dealers.

Q: Should I choose the 5310 2WD or 4WD?

The 4WD gives extra grip in wet paddy, for puddling and with heavy loads on soft ground. The 2WD suits dry-land work and road haulage, and costs less. We help you choose on a test drive.

## Odisha Tractor Subsidy 2026: How to Apply in Ganjam
URL: https://www.sabitatraders.com/odisha-tractor-subsidy-2026-guide.html

Home › Blog › Odisha tractor subsidy 2026

ODISHA SUBSIDY GUIDE · UPDATED 17 NOV 2026

## Odisha tractor subsidy 2026: how to apply in Ganjam

Under Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation scheme, a Ganjam farmer gets ₹1,20,000 off a tractor up to 48 HP, or ₹1,50,000 for 50 HP and above, paid into the farmer’s Aadhaar-linked bank account. You book on the FM-DBT portal while Ganjam has target, choose an enlisted dealer, and finish payment and delivery within the permit’s validity.

By M Krishna Reddy, Managing Director, Sabita Traders · Published 17 Nov 2026 · Updated 21 Nov 2026 · 6 min read

WhatsApp for help applying Check your tractor’s HP band

### Quick answer

- Subsidy: ₹1,20,000 for tractors up to 48 HP; ₹1,50,000 for 50 HP and above (subject to eligibility and DBT approval).

- Where to apply: register once on Go-Sugam, then book on the FM-DBT portal ( fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in).

- Permit: valid 30 days if you pay yourself, 45 days with a bank loan.

- Next tractor target top-ups: 1 Dec and 15 Dec 2026, 1 Jan and 15 Jan 2027. Booking reopens at 3 PM on those days.

- Payment: the subsidy goes into your Aadhaar-linked bank account after the dealer’s verification.

### How much is the Odisha tractor subsidy in 2026?

The subsidy depends on the tractor’s engine power:

Tractor power | Subsidy | John Deere models in this band

Up to 48 HP | ₹1,20,000 | 3036EN (35 HP, 4WD), 5036D (36 HP, 2WD), 5105 (40 HP, 2WD & 4WD), 5039D PowerPro (41 HP, 2WD), 5042D PowerPro (44 HP, 2WD), 5045D PowerPro (46 HP, 2WD & 4WD)

50 HP and above | ₹1,50,000 | 5050D (50 HP, 2WD & 4WD), 5310 (57 HP, 2WD & 4WD), 5405 (63 HP, 2WD & 4WD), 5075E (76 HP, 4WD)

Subsidy amounts are set by the Government of Odisha and are paid only after DBT approval. Implements such as rotavators and cultivators have their own subsidy under the same programme.

### Who can apply?

Any farmer in Odisha with a valid Farmer ID can apply, whatever the land size. Groups such as Pani Panchayats, women’s self-help groups and cooperatives can apply through a nominated member.

Two rules to know before you apply:

- You must keep the tractor for 5 years. Selling it earlier can lead to recovery of the subsidy.

- Tractor-drawn implements are only for tractor owners, one of each type per tractor registration.

### What documents do you need?

- Farmer ID (Krushak Odisha)

- Aadhaar linked to your Farmer ID

- Aadhaar linked to your bank account (the subsidy is paid through the Aadhaar-Based Payment System)

- Your registered mobile number, for the OTPs at every step

- For a bank loan: a CIBIL score above 700, plus the lender’s usual papers, such as land records, bank statements, PAN and photographs

If your Farmer ID is not linked to Aadhaar, your Block Agriculture Officer can add it.

### How to apply, step by step

- Register. Register on Krushak Odisha and Go-Sugam (sugam.odisha.gov.in) with your Farmer ID, Aadhaar and mobile number.

- Log in to FM-DBT. From 2026-27, tractors are booked and permits issued on the FM-DBT portal (fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in). Log in with your Farmer ID and Aadhaar and confirm the OTP.

- Book while Ganjam has target. Bookings open in phases and are held for 10 days.

- Choose make, model and dealer. Select John Deere, your model and Sabita Traders from the dealers listed for Ganjam. We give you an offer price the same day.

- Print the permit. It is valid for 30 days if you pay yourself, or 45 days with a bank loan.

- Pay and take delivery. Pay online, or your bank issues a delivery order. Delivery is done with Aadhaar verification, within the permit’s validity.

- Verification. We upload GPS-tagged photos and the invoice. Some machines are physically inspected.

- Subsidy credited. The subsidy is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account.

Not sure about the portal? We will help you book. Send us your village and the tractor you have in mind. We check Ganjam’s target, help you book on FM-DBT and arrange the loan before the permit clock starts. WhatsApp 89085 89085

### When are new tractor targets released?

Each district, Ganjam included, gets a yearly target for each machine. From the Agriculture Department’s 31 Oct 2026 notice, new tractor targets under the State Pool are uploaded twice a month:

Month | Target top-up dates

November 2026 | 2 Nov and 16 Nov (done)

December 2026 | 1 Dec and 15 Dec

January 2027 | 1 Jan and 15 Jan

On those days the portal is closed from 2 PM to 3 PM, and tractor booking reopens at 3 PM. Targets can fill quickly, so keep your documents ready and book early.

### Key time limits

Booking held | 10 days

Permit, paying yourself | 30 days

Permit, with a bank loan | 45 days

Change of model | Once, within 25 days

If the permit lapses | Re-apply after 3 months

### Can you take the subsidy with a tractor loan?

Yes. Start the loan file before you book, because the bank must issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit. If the loan is late, the permit can lapse and you would have to wait 3 months to re-apply.

We work with John Deere Financial, banks and finance companies. For a tractor loan, your CIBIL score should be above 700. Use our EMI calculator to plan the down payment and instalments.

Target full, permit lapsed or loan rejected? See what to do if you are not eligible for the subsidy.

### What if the farmer dies before delivery?

From the procedure posted on the FM-DBT portal on 5 Nov 2026: if the farmer paid but died before the online supply was completed, a legal heir can get the subsidy and the machine. The spouse comes first, unless they authorise another heir by notarised affidavit.

The heir submits the death certificate, the legal heir certificate from the Tahasildar, an NOC affidavit if there are several heirs, and their own Aadhaar, Voter ID, Farmer ID and bank details at the CDAO office. A district committee checks them and the subsidy is paid into the heir’s bank account.

Tractor on-road price: what is added to the MRP ›

### Sources

- FM-DBT portal, Department of Agriculture and Farmers’ Empowerment, Government of Odisha

- Go-Sugam, Government of Odisha single-window portal

- Government of Odisha, Operational Modality for Farm Mechanisation in DBT mode (2026)

- Government of Odisha, Operational Modality DBT-FM (2024)

- Krushak Odisha (farmer registration)

### Questions farmers ask us

Q: How much subsidy do I get on a John Deere 5045D?

The 5045D PowerPro is 46 HP, so it falls in the up-to-48 HP band: ₹1,20,000, subject to eligibility and DBT approval.

Q: How much subsidy do I get on a 50 HP tractor like the 5050D?

₹1,50,000. Tractors of 50 HP and above get the higher amount, subject to eligibility and DBT approval.

Q: Where do I apply for the Odisha tractor subsidy?

Register once on Go-Sugam, then book the tractor and get the permit on the FM-DBT portal, fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in. We can guide you through it.

Q: When is the next tractor booking date in Ganjam?

New tractor targets are uploaded on 1 Dec and 15 Dec 2026, and on 1 Jan and 15 Jan 2027. Booking reopens at 3 PM on those days.

Q: What CIBIL score do I need for a tractor loan?

Your CIBIL score should be above 700. Start the loan file before you book on FM-DBT, so the bank can issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit.

Q: How long is the subsidy permit valid?

30 days if you pay yourself and 45 days if you buy with a bank loan. Finish payment and delivery within that time.

Q: Can I sell the tractor after taking the subsidy?

You must keep it for 5 years. Selling it earlier can lead to recovery of the subsidy.

Q: Is Sabita Traders an enlisted dealer for Ganjam?

Yes. Sabita Traders in Berhampur is the only authorised John Deere tractor dealer for Ganjam district. Select us from the dealers listed for Ganjam on the portal.

## Not Eligible for Tractor Subsidy in Odisha? What to Do (2026)
URL: https://www.sabitatraders.com/tractor-subsidy-not-eligible-odisha.html

Home › Blog › Not eligible for subsidy?

SUBSIDY HELP · UPDATED 20 NOV 2026

## Not eligible for the tractor subsidy? Here is what you can still do

Most reasons for missing the Odisha tractor subsidy are temporary or can be fixed. If the target was full, book in the next release. If your permit lapsed, apply again after 3 months. If you took a subsidy in the last 5 years, you can get it again once the 5 years are over, at a reduced amount. If you can’t wait, a tractor loan with a trade-in or a co-applicant can get you a tractor this season.

By M Krishna Reddy, Managing Director, Sabita Traders · Published 20 Nov 2026 · 7 min read

Ask us your best route Find your reason

### Quick answer

- Target full? Book in the next release: 1 Dec and 15 Dec 2026, 1 Jan and 15 Jan 2027, from 3 PM.

- Permit lapsed? Apply again 3 months after it expired.

- Subsidy in the last 5 years? After 5 years you can get it again, at 75% of the normal amount the second time.

- No land in your name? Not a barrier for the subsidy: you need a Farmer ID, Aadhaar and mobile number.

- Can’t wait? Buy now with a tractor loan, a trade-in or a co-applicant.

Haven’t applied yet? Start with our Odisha tractor subsidy 2026 guide.

### Find your reason in 30 seconds

Tap your reason for the full steps, or tap Ask us to send it to us on WhatsApp.

Why you didn’t get it | What it means | Best next step | Typical wait | Help

No Farmer ID or Go-Sugam registration | You can’t book without them | Register on Krushak Odisha, then Go-Sugam | Days to weeks | Ask us ›

Ganjam target was full | No slots left in that release | Book in the next release, or buy now with a loan | Up to 2 weeks | Ask us ›

Permit lapsed | Payment or bank delivery order came too late | Get the loan ready, apply again after 3 months | 3 months | Ask us ›

Subsidy taken in the last 5 years | You are inside the 5-year waiting period | Wait (reduced subsidy) or buy with a loan | Until 5 years end | Ask us ›

Implement subsidy refused | No tractor in your name, or that implement already claimed on your RC | Buy the tractor first, or rent the implement | Varies | Ask us ›

Tractor loan rejected | Low CIBIL score or weak papers | Fix your credit, add a co-applicant, pay more down | 1–6 months | Ask us ›

### 1. “I don’t have a Farmer ID”

You don’t need to own land. Odisha’s farm mechanisation rules say every farmer registered with Krushak Odisha and Go-Sugam, with a valid Farmer ID, Aadhaar and mobile number, can apply whatever the size of their land.

- Register on krushak.odisha.gov.in, then on sugam.odisha.gov.in.

- If you farm leased or shared land, ask your Krushi Sahayak or Block Agriculture Officer which papers to show.

- Link your Aadhaar to your Farmer ID and to your bank account. The subsidy is paid into that account.

### 2. “The target was full”

Subsidy slots are released in rounds, and Ganjam’s share can fill within hours. The Agriculture Department’s notice of 31 Oct 2026 lists the next tractor target releases as 1 Dec and 15 Dec 2026, and 1 Jan and 15 Jan 2027, with booking reopening at 3 PM.

- Keep your documents and loan file ready before release day.

- Decide your model in advance: ₹1,20,000 subsidy up to 48 HP, ₹1,50,000 from 50 HP ( see which models).

- WhatsApp us before the release date and we help you book at 3 PM.

- If the crop season can’t wait, buy now with a loan (section 6). Weigh the subsidy against the cost of a lost season.

Missed the target? Don’t miss the next one. Send us your village and the tractor you want. We keep your papers and loan ready, and book with you at 3 PM on release day. Reserve help for the next release

### 3. “My permit lapsed”

A permit is valid for 30 days if you pay yourself and 45 days with a bank loan. Under clause 5.11 of the official rules, a farmer whose booking or permit lapses must apply again after three months from the date the last permit expired.

- Use the 3 months to get the bank loan approved in principle, so the bank can issue its delivery order quickly next time.

- Note the date you can apply again, and book on the first target release after it.

### 4. “I took a subsidy in the last 5 years”

This is not a lifetime ban. Clause 2.1 of the 2026 rules allows the subsidy again on the same machine after its 5-year moratorium, at 100%, 75% and 50% of the normal assistance for the first, second and third purchase.

Tractor power | First subsidy | Second subsidy (75%)*

Up to 48 HP | ₹1,20,000 | about ₹90,000

50 HP and above | ₹1,50,000 | about ₹1,12,500

*Our calculation from the official 75% rule. Confirm the amount with your Block Agriculture Officer.

Remember: a subsidised tractor must stay with you for 5 years. Selling it earlier can lead to recovery of the subsidy.

### 5. “My implement subsidy was refused”

Tractor-drawn implements are subsidised only for farmers who own a tractor, and each implement type can be claimed once per tractor registration (RC).

- Buy the tractor first, then apply for the implement on your own RC. See our implements.

- If you need an implement only a few weeks a year, renting may cost less (section 8).

### 6. “I can’t wait. How do I buy without the subsidy?”

A tractor loan is the most common route. The lender pays most of the price and you pay the rest as a down payment.

What to keep ready:

- CIBIL score above 700. This is what our finance partners generally look for.

- Aadhaar, PAN, photographs, bank statements and income proof. Land records help where you have them.

- Down payment money. A bigger down payment means a smaller EMI and often an easier approval.

Ways to pay less upfront:

- Trade in your old tractor. Its value goes towards the down payment. Check your exchange value.

- Keep your Kisan Credit Card for crop costs. KCC crop loans are at 7%, and paying on time earns 3% more interest relief, on limits up to ₹3 lakh. Using KCC for seed and fertiliser keeps your own cash free for the down payment. KCC itself is not a tractor loan.

- Compare lenders. We work with 11 finance partners, including John Deere Financial, SBI, HDFC Bank and Shriram Finance, so you get more than one offer.

Plan your monthly payment with our tractor loan EMI calculator.

Get loan offers from more than one lender Tell us the tractor you want and your village. We check with our finance partners and tell you the down payment and EMI before you visit. Get loan options on WhatsApp

### 7. “My loan was rejected”

- Check your CIBIL report. You can get one free report a year from CIBIL. Look for old unpaid dues or mistakes and get them corrected.

- Clear overdue EMIs and give your score time to improve.

- Add a co-applicant, such as a family member with a good credit record and income.

- Pay a bigger down payment so the lender takes less risk.

- Know the ₹2 lakh rule. RBI asks banks to waive collateral and margin on agricultural loans up to ₹2 lakh per borrower. Tractor loans are usually bigger, so expect the lender to ask for security on the amount above that.

### 8. Other routes: buy as a group, or rent

Buy through a group. Pani Panchayats, women’s self-help groups and cooperatives can apply for the subsidy through a nominated member. Under clause 4.1, up to 33% of targets can go to women’s self-help groups, at 75% of the normal subsidy for selected commercially viable machines. The subsidy is lower, but it is a separate share of the target when the general one is full.

Group credit for landless and small farmers. Odisha’s Balaram scheme helps landless, small and marginal farmers form groups of at least 5 farmers to borrow from banks together. These amounts suit crop inputs and small equipment better than a whole tractor.

Rent. Pani Panchayats, self-help groups and cooperatives near you may run hiring centres that rent tractors and implements by the hour or by the acre. On a small farm, renting can cost less than an EMI.

Want to run a tractor hire business? The central Agriculture Infrastructure Fund supports Custom Hiring Centres with at least 4 machines or implements. That is a business plan rather than a personal purchase, and we will cover it in a separate guide.

### Mistakes that cost farmers the subsidy next time

- Booking before the bank loan is ready, so the 45-day permit lapses.

- Aadhaar not linked to the Farmer ID or the bank account.

- Choosing the model only on release day, after the slots are gone.

- Selling a subsidised tractor before 5 years.

- Applying for an implement before the tractor is registered in your name.

### Questions farmers ask us

Q: Can I get a tractor subsidy a second time in Odisha?

Yes, after the 5-year waiting period for that machine. The official rules pay 100% of the normal subsidy the first time, 75% the second time and 50% the third time.

Q: Can a tenant farmer or a farmer without land get the tractor subsidy?

Odisha’s rules let any farmer registered on Krushak Odisha and Go-Sugam, with a valid Farmer ID, Aadhaar and mobile number, apply regardless of land size. If you farm leased land, ask your Block Agriculture Officer which papers to show for the Farmer ID.

Q: My subsidy permit lapsed. When can I apply again?

Three months after the date your last permit expired.

Q: When are the next tractor subsidy target releases in Ganjam?

Per the Agriculture Department notice of 31 Oct 2026: 1 Dec and 15 Dec 2026, and 1 Jan and 15 Jan 2027. Tractor booking reopens at 3 PM on those days.

Q: Can I buy a tractor on loan without the subsidy?

Yes. Most lenders look for a CIBIL score above 700, KYC and income proof, and a down payment. A trade-in or a co-applicant can make approval easier.

Q: Is a tractor loan collateral-free?

RBI asks banks to waive collateral and margin on agricultural loans up to ₹2 lakh per borrower. Tractor loans are usually bigger, so lenders normally ask for security on the amount above that.

Q: Can I use my Kisan Credit Card to buy a tractor?

No. KCC is short-term credit for crop and allied costs. Using it for those costs can keep your own cash free for the tractor down payment.

## Privacy notice

Updated 20 November 2026

### Who we are

Sabita Traders (partnership firm), authorised John Deere tractor dealer, NH5 Pathara Byepass Junction, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur, Odisha 760007. GSTIN 21AEOFS3076G1ZY. Contact: 89085 89085 · 1sabitatraders@gmail.com

### What this website collects

Your enquiries. Our forms do not store your details on this website. When you tap “Send on WhatsApp”, your own WhatsApp opens with the message ready. Nothing is sent until you press send. The message also carries a short tag naming the page you came from, so we know what you were looking at.

Visit statistics. We use Google Analytics to count page visits and taps on buttons such as WhatsApp and Call. It uses cookies and does not tell us who you are. We use it only to improve the site.

Language choice. If you switch to Odia, your phone or computer remembers it. That choice stays on your device and is not sent to us.

Videos and maps. John Deere videos load from YouTube only when you tap play. The contact page shows a Google Map. Both are Google services and follow Google’s privacy policy.

### How we use your details

Only to reply to you: prices, test drives, service bookings, exchange valuations, and help with a loan or subsidy application you ask us for. We do not sell your details. We share them with a bank, finance company or the government subsidy portal only when you ask us to help with that application.

### How long we keep them

Only as long as we need them to serve you, and as long as tax and legal records require.

### Your choices

WhatsApp or email us to see, correct or delete the details you have given us. You can also block cookies in your browser settings; the site will still work.

### Changes

If this notice changes, we will update the date at the top.

## Best Tractor for Paddy Puddling in Ganjam: 2WD or 4WD? (2026)
URL: https://www.sabitatraders.com/best-tractor-for-paddy-puddling-ganjam.html

Home › Blog › Tractor for puddling

PADDY GUIDE · 21 NOV 2026

## Best tractor for paddy puddling in Ganjam: 2WD or 4WD, how much HP, which implement

For puddling in Ganjam’s wet paddy fields, choose a 4WD tractor of about 45–50 HP. Four in five of our buyers choose 4WD, and the 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP) is the tractor Ganjam farmers buy most from us. Pair it with a Paddy Special Rotary Tiller or a Puddler cum Leveler.

By M Krishna Reddy, Managing Director, Sabita Traders · Published 21 Nov 2026 · 5 min read

Ask which tractor suits my land See the models

### Quick answer

- Choose 4WD for puddling. The front wheels also pull, so the tractor keeps moving in deep mud. Four in five of our buyers choose 4WD (our sales, June 2022 – Oct 2026).

- About 45–50 HP pulls both John Deere puddling implements. The Puddler cum Leveler needs 44 HP or more.

- Ganjam’s most bought: the 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP), 39 of our 84 tractor sales since June 2022.

- Two implements for puddling: the Paddy Special Rotary Tiller and the Puddler cum Leveler.

- Subsidy: ₹1.2 lakh up to 48 HP, ₹1.5 lakh for 50 HP and above. Implements have their own subsidy for tractor owners.

### 1. Why puddling matters in Ganjam

Paddy is Ganjam’s biggest crop: the district agriculture department puts it at 2,23,500 hectares, and estimates the irrigated area at about 61% in kharif and 12% in rabi ( Ganjam district, Agriculture).

Puddling churns and levels the wet field before transplanting rice, for better weed control and less water use. It is slow, heavy work in deep mud, so the tractor you choose matters more for puddling than for any other job.

### 2. 2WD or 4WD for puddling?

- 4WD: the front axle also drives, so the tractor pulls through deep mud instead of digging in. The 5045D 4WD also has bigger 8.0 × 18 front tyres. It is our best seller for wet land.

- 2WD: costs less and suits dry land, ploughing and haulage.

Our advice: if most of your work is wet paddy, buy 4WD. If it is mostly haulage and dry ploughing, 2WD saves you money.

### 3. How much HP? John Deere models that suit puddling

Model | Puddling implements it pulls | MRP / after subsidy (4WD)

5105 4WD, 40 HP | Paddy Special Rotary Tiller | ₹8.80 / ₹7.60 lakh

5045D PowerPro 4WD, 46 HP | Rotary Tiller, Puddler cum Leveler | ₹10.00 / ₹8.80 lakh

5050D 4WD, 50 HP | Rotary Tiller, Puddler cum Leveler | ₹11.00 / ₹9.50 lakh

Indicative prices, tractor only. The lower figure is after the Odisha subsidy (subject to eligibility and DBT approval). What goes into the on-road price ›

John Deere also makes Puddling Special versions for paddy fields. Ask us which one is right for your land. Not sure between models? See our model comparison.

Not sure which tractor suits your land? Tell us your land size and village. We suggest the tractor and implement, and give you today’s on-road price. Ask on WhatsApp

### 4. Which implement: rotary tiller or puddler?

- Paddy Special Rotary Tiller (1.65 m or 1.85 m working width): prepares a smooth seedbed for transplanting and mixes in weeds and residue. It is sealed against water and mud. Pulled by the 5105, 5045D and 5050D.

- Puddler cum Leveler (7 ft working width): puddles and levels the field before transplanting. It needs 44 HP or more, so pair it with the 5045D or 5050D.

Implements are subsidised separately, only for farmers who own a tractor, and each implement type can be claimed once per tractor registration. See all John Deere implements for Ganjam.

### 5. When to buy before the paddy season

Most of our buyers buy in March–April and in July. Start your loan and subsidy paperwork 4–6 weeks before you need the tractor, so the permit doesn’t lapse. Our Odisha tractor subsidy guide has the steps and the next target dates.

### 6. See one working near you

### Questions farmers ask us

Q: Is 2WD enough for paddy puddling?

In shallow or firm wet fields a 2WD can manage. In deep mud a 4WD pulls better, because the front wheels also drive. Four in five of our buyers choose 4WD.

Q: What is the best tractor for puddling in Ganjam?

Most of our buyers choose the John Deere 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP): 39 of our 84 tractor sales since June 2022. It pulls both the Paddy Special Rotary Tiller and the Puddler cum Leveler.

Q: Can a 40 HP tractor do puddling?

Yes. The John Deere 5105 4WD (40 HP) pulls the Paddy Special Rotary Tiller. For the Puddler cum Leveler, choose 44 HP or more, such as the 5045D or 5050D.

Q: How much HP do I need for a puddler?

The John Deere Puddler cum Leveler needs 44 HP or more. The 5045D PowerPro (46 HP) and 5050D (50 HP) both pull it.

Q: Is there a subsidy on the puddler or rotary tiller in Odisha?

Yes, under Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation scheme, but only for farmers who own a tractor, and each implement type once per tractor registration.

## Tractor On-Road Price in Odisha: What Is Added to the MRP (2026)
URL: https://www.sabitatraders.com/tractor-on-road-price-odisha.html

Home › Blog › On-road price explained

BUYING GUIDE · 21 NOV 2026

## Tractor on-road price in Odisha: what is added to the MRP

The on-road price of a tractor is the tractor price plus RTO registration and insurance, plus any implements or accessories you choose. Under Odisha’s DBT scheme the subsidy is paid into your bank account after verification, so it is not taken off at the counter. WhatsApp us for today’s on-road price for your model.

By M Krishna Reddy, Managing Director, Sabita Traders · Published 21 Nov 2026 · 4 min read

Get today’s on-road price What is added

### Quick answer

- On-road price = tractor price + RTO registration + insurance, plus any implements or accessories you choose.

- Subsidy: under Odisha’s DBT scheme it is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account after verification. It is not taken off at the counter.

- With a loan: you pay the down payment, and the lender’s name is entered on the RC (hypothecation).

- Exact figures: WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price. It depends on the model, variant, offers and your choices.

### 1. What the MRP covers

The MRP on our website is for the tractor only, as on our John Deere price list. It does not include registration, insurance, implements, fitments or accessories. See each model’s MRP and after-subsidy price on our tractor list.

### 2. What is added to reach the on-road price

- RTO registration. A tractor used on public roads must be registered under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988. In Ganjam district that is the Ganjam RTO (OD07) or the Bhanjanagar RTO (OD32), with road tax and fees paid. Papers: application (Form 20), sale invoice, insurance, ID and address proof, and the manufacturer’s certificate.

- Insurance. Third-party insurance is compulsory for a tractor used on public roads. Comprehensive cover also protects your own tractor against accidents, fire and theft. Insurance is needed at registration, so you are covered from day one.

- Your choices. Implements, fitments and accessories cost extra, and only if you want them.

Ask for your on-road price in writing Send us the model and your village. We break the on-road price down for you on WhatsApp. Get today’s on-road price

### 3. How the subsidy lowers your cost

Under Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation scheme, the subsidy is ₹1,20,000 for tractors up to 48 HP and ₹1,50,000 for 50 HP and above, subject to eligibility. It is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account after the dealer’s verification, so plan to pay the full price first, from your own money or a loan. Our Odisha tractor subsidy guide explains how to book and the next target dates.

### 4. If you take a loan

You pay the down payment and the lender pays the rest. The lender’s name is entered on the RC (hypothecation) until the loan is closed. If you are also taking the subsidy, start the loan file before you book: with a bank loan the permit is valid for 45 days, and the bank must issue the delivery order within it. Work out your monthly payment with our EMI calculator, and see if your old tractor can be your down payment.

### 5. How we help

- We help you with RTO registration and insurance.

- We follow up your subsidy application until it is credited.

- We compare loan offers from our 11 finance partners, including John Deere Financial and SBI.

### Questions farmers ask us

Q: Why is the on-road price higher than the MRP?

Because RTO registration (road tax and fees) and insurance are added to the tractor price. Implements and accessories are extra only if you choose them.

Q: Is the Odisha tractor subsidy deducted from the price?

No. Under the DBT scheme the subsidy is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account after the dealer’s verification. You pay the full price first, from your own money or a loan.

Q: Is tractor insurance compulsory?

Third-party insurance is compulsory for a tractor used on public roads, and it is needed at registration. Comprehensive cover is optional and also protects your own tractor.

Q: Can I insure the tractor myself?

Yes, you can choose your insurer. We can also help you arrange it.

Q: Which RTO registers tractors in Ganjam?

The Ganjam RTO (OD07) or the Bhanjanagar RTO (OD32), depending on where you live.

## Which 40–50 HP John Deere Tractor to Buy in Ganjam? (2026)
URL: https://www.sabitatraders.com/choose-40-50-hp-john-deere-tractor-ganjam.html

Home › Blog › Choosing a 40–50 HP tractor

BUYING GUIDE · 22 NOV 2026
## Which 40–50 HP John Deere tractor should you buy in Ganjam? 5105 vs 5039D vs 5045D vs 5050D
Start with your work, not the HP. For wet paddy, most Ganjam farmers do best with the 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP), the tractor they buy most from us. Pick the 5105 if budget comes first, the 5039D PowerPro for dry land and PTO work, and the 5050D for the heaviest jobs.
By M Krishna Reddy, Managing Director, Sabita Traders · Published 22 Nov 2026 · 6 min read
Ask which model suits my workSee the four side by side

### Quick answer

- Wet paddy and puddling: 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP). It is Ganjam’s most bought: 39 of our 84 tractor sales since June 2022.
- Tightest budget: 5105 (40 HP), from ₹6.20 lakh after subsidy for the 2WD.
- Dry land and PTO work: 5039D PowerPro (41 HP). John Deere India lists it as 2WD only.
- Heaviest work and haulage: 5050D (50 HP), with 1,800 kg lift and a bigger ₹1.5 lakh subsidy.
- All four: oil-immersed brakes and John Deere’s 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty.
### 1. Start with your work, not the HP
All four tractors are 40–50 HP John Deere D Series models with 3-cylinder engines and oil-immersed brakes. The right one depends on what you will do most with it:

Your main work | Our suggestion | Why |
Wet paddy, puddling | 5045D PowerPro 4WD (or 5105 4WD on a tighter budget) | 4WD pulls through mud; the 5045D pulls both John Deere puddling implements |
Dry land, rabi crops, PTO jobs | 5039D PowerPro or 5105 2WD | 2WD costs less; John Deere describes the 5039D for all farm work, including crop management such as baling |
Sugarcane haulage, heavy trolleys | 5050D 2WD | The most power of the four and 1,800 kg lift; high backup torque for heavy work |
Heavy work in wet or tough land | 5050D 4WD | Durable front-wheel-drive axle for traction |
Mixed work, small budget | 5105 (2WD or 4WD) | The lowest price of the four; described by John Deere for dry and wet farming |
### 2. 2WD or 4WD?

- 4WD also drives the front wheels, so it grips better in wet paddy, puddling and soft land. Four in five of our buyers choose 4WD (our sales, June 2022 – Oct 2026).
- 2WD costs ₹1.40–1.70 lakh less (MRP) and suits dry land, haulage and trolley work.
- The 5105, 5045D and 5050D come in both. The 5039D PowerPro is 2WD only.
More on this in our paddy puddling guide.
### 3. The four at a glance

Model | Power, drive | Lift capacity | Price after subsidy – MRP |

### 4. What the extra HP gets you

- Lift: the 5045D and 5050D lift 1,800 kg; the 5105 and 5039D lift 1,600 kg. That matters for heavier mounted implements.
- Implements: the John Deere Puddler cum Leveler needs 44 HP or more, so it suits the 5045D or 5050D. The Paddy Special Rotary Tiller works with the 5105, 5045D and 5050D. See all implements.
- Weight: 1,760 kg for the 5105 and 5039D, 1,850 kg for the 5045D and 1,880 kg for the 5050D (John Deere India figures).
### 5. The subsidy narrows the gap to 50 HP
Odisha’s tractor subsidy is ₹1.2 lakh up to 48 HP and ₹1.5 lakh for 50 HP and above. So the 5050D gets ₹30,000 more subsidy than the 5045D:

- 4WD: the MRP gap between the 5045D and 5050D is ₹1.00 lakh; after subsidy it is ₹70,000.
- 2WD: the MRP gap is ₹70,000; after subsidy it is ₹40,000.
If you were already close to choosing the 5050D, the subsidy makes it easier. See our Odisha subsidy guide for eligibility, our EMI calculator for the monthly payment, and what is added to the on-road price.

### Questions farmers ask us

Q: Which is the best 40–50 HP John Deere tractor for Ganjam?
It depends on your work. For wet paddy, most of our buyers choose the 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP): 39 of our 84 tractor sales since June 2022. For dry land on a budget, the 5105 or 5039D PowerPro; for the heaviest work, the 5050D.

Q: What is the difference between the John Deere 5045D and 5050D?
The 5050D has 50 HP against 46 HP, weighs 1,880 kg against 1,850 kg, and gets ₹1.5 lakh subsidy instead of ₹1.2 lakh. Both lift 1,800 kg and come in 2WD and 4WD. After subsidy, the 4WD 5050D costs ₹70,000 more than the 4WD 5045D.

Q: Is the John Deere 5039D available in 4WD?
John Deere India lists the 5039D PowerPro as a 2WD tractor. For wet paddy work, look at the 5045D PowerPro 4WD or the 5105 4WD.

Q: Which is the cheapest of the four?
The 5105 2WD: ₹6.20 lakh after the Odisha subsidy, ₹7.40 lakh MRP (tractor only, indicative). The subsidy is subject to eligibility and DBT approval.

Q: Do all four have the same warranty?
Yes. All four carry John Deere’s 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty, as long as the tractor is serviced on schedule.

## John Deere 5036D or 5045D for a Small Farm in Ganjam?
URL: https://www.sabitatraders.com/john-deere-5036d-vs-5045d-small-farm-ganjam.html

Home › Blog › 5036D or 5045D

BUYING GUIDE · 26 NOV 2026
## John Deere 5036D or 5045D for a small farm in Ganjam?
Start with your land, not the acres. If you puddle wet paddy every kharif, buy the 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP). If your fields are mostly dry or upland and you till, sow and haul, the 5036D (36 HP) does the job for ₹1.90 lakh less.
By M Krishna Reddy, Managing Director, Sabita Traders · Published 26 Nov 2026 · 5 min read
### Quick answer
- Wet paddy you puddle: 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP). The 5036D is 2WD only, and John Deere’s Puddler cum Leveler needs 44 HP or more.
- Dry or upland land, tight budget: 5036D (36 HP), ₹5.50 lakh after subsidy: ₹1.90 lakh less than the 5045D 2WD.
- Same subsidy: both get ₹1.2 lakh (up to 48 HP), so the price gap does not shrink after subsidy.
- Both: John Deere 3029D 3-cylinder engine, oil-immersed brakes, power steering, 60 L tank and the 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty.
### 1. Start with your land, not the acres
A small farm can still need a 46 HP tractor if the land is wet. What decides it is the work you do most:
Your land and work | Our suggestion | Why |
Wet paddy you puddle every kharif | 5045D PowerPro 4WD | 4WD also drives the front wheels for grip in mud; John Deere’s Puddler cum Leveler needs 44 HP or more |
Dry or upland fields: tilling, sowing, rabi crops | 5036D | Made for tilling and sowing with a rotary tiller, cultivator or seed drill, at the lowest price of any John Deere on our list |
First tractor, or moving up from a power tiller | 5036D | Lowest cost to start; same 3-cylinder John Deere 3029D engine family as the 5045D |
Trolley haulage on the road | 5036D or 5045D 2WD | The 5036D is faster on the road (34.18 km/h top speed); the 5045D has 10 HP more for heavier trolleys |
Heavier implements now or later | 5045D PowerPro | Lifts 1,800 kg against 1,600 kg, and more John Deere implements are matched to it |
Ganjam’s wet paddy is why the 5045D PowerPro 4WD is our best seller: 39 of our 84 tractor sales since June 2022, and four in five of our buyers choose 4WD.
### 2. The 5036D and 5045D side by side

### 3. What the extra ₹1.90 lakh buys
- Power: 46 HP against 36 HP, from the same 3029D engine family.
- Lift: 1,800 kg against 1,600 kg, for heavier mounted implements.
- 4WD option: only the 5045D comes in 4WD (₹1.40 lakh more than its 2WD at MRP).
- Implements: the Puddler cum Leveler, the Seed cum Fertilizer Drill and the MB Plough on our implements page are listed for the 5045D. For the 5036D, ask us to match the implement size.
- Ground clearance: 450 mm against 390 mm.
Both get the same ₹1.2 lakh subsidy, so the gap stays ₹1.90 lakh (2WD) or ₹3.30 lakh (4WD). Use our EMI calculator to see what that means each month, and see what is added to the on-road price.
### 4. Who should buy which
Choose the 5036D if:
- most of your land is dry or upland, and you till, sow and haul;
- it is your first tractor, or you are moving up from a power tiller;
- budget is the main limit.
Choose the 5045D PowerPro if:
- you puddle wet paddy every kharif (take the 4WD);
- you want the Puddler cum Leveler or other heavier implements;
- you expect bigger jobs in the years ahead and want the extra lift.

### Questions farmers ask us

Q: Is the John Deere 5036D enough for a small farm in Ganjam?
For dry or upland fields where you till, sow and haul, yes: John Deere rates it at 36 HP with 1,600 kg lift. If you puddle wet paddy every season, we suggest the 5045D PowerPro 4WD instead, because the 5036D is 2WD only and John Deere’s Puddler cum Leveler needs 44 HP or more.

Q: Is the John Deere 5036D available in 4WD?
No. John Deere India lists the 5036D as a 2WD tractor. For wet paddy work, look at the 5045D PowerPro 4WD.

Q: How much more does the 5045D cost than the 5036D?
After the Odisha subsidy, the 5036D is ₹5.50 lakh, the 5045D PowerPro 2WD ₹7.40 lakh and the 4WD ₹8.80 lakh: ₹1.90 lakh and ₹3.30 lakh more (tractor only, indicative). Both get the same ₹1.2 lakh subsidy, so the gap is the same before and after subsidy.

Q: Do the 5036D and 5045D get the same subsidy?
Yes. Odisha’s tractor subsidy is ₹1.2 lakh for tractors up to 48 HP, which covers both, subject to eligibility and DBT approval.

Q: Which lifts more, the 5036D or the 5045D?
The 5045D PowerPro lifts 1,800 kg and the 5036D 1,600 kg, through the full lift range at the coupling points (John Deere India figures).
